articles.title: Anhui Conch Cement Co Ltd's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: Anhui Conch Cement Co Ltd (AHCHY) recently announced a total dividend of $0.1 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-09. This payment includes a $0.1 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-10-20. As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
